vetSays.line: 🛡️ Patrick, Cheyenne and Ezra met them at the door — 3 put down. Patrick, Cheyenne, Ezra are hurt.
🛡️ Patrick, Cheyenne and Ezra met them at the door — 3 put down. Patrick, Cheyenne, Ezra are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Cheyenne, Ezra, Temirlan and Muhoro met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Cheyenne, Ezra, Temirlan, Muhoro are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Muhoro just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Onni just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Cheyenne, Ezra, Muhoro, Onni and Katarina met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Cheyenne, Ezra, Muhoro, Onni are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ezra just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Katarina just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Cheyenne, Ezra, Muhoro, Onni and Katarina met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Cheyenne, Ezra, Muhoro, Katarina are hurt.
🛡️ Cheyenne, Ezra, Muhoro, Onni and Nora met them at the door — 5 put down. Cheyenne, Ezra, Nora are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Nina taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
You start in on Sassafras, European Elder too — and they grin. "Old news, friend. Tariq showed us that one." Still: you carried it home. That's the job.
🛡️ Tariq, Sneha and Nina met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Tariq, Sneha, Nina are hurt.

Jovan has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Nina passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sneha just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Tariq, Sneha and Nina met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Nina didn't come back. Tariq, Sneha are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
🛡️ Jovan, Zoltan and Dylan met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Jovan, Zoltan, Dylan are hurt.
